build_bert_sequence_classifier: build a BERT model for sequence classification using BertForSequenceClassification with a custom number of labels
build_bert_question_answering: build a BERT model for extractive question answering using BertForQuestionAnswering to predict start and end span logits
build_bert_masked_lm: build a BERT masked language model using BertForMaskedLM to predict masked token probabilities
build_bert_token_classifier: build a BERT model for token classification using BertForTokenClassification for NER tasks
build_bert_multiple_choice: build a BERT model for multiple choice classification using BertForMultipleChoice for tasks like SWAG
